about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the relentless world of Reignbreaker with its explosive, genre-defying soundtrack. Featuring an electrifying mix of dark rock and medieval influences, this soundtrack captures the game’s brutal intensity, from eerie dungeon ambiences to pulse-pounding boss battles.

Composed by AudioCreatures, the in-game music blends medieval instruments with raw, modern energy, forging a soundscape that’s as immersive as it is intense. Topping it all off, the title track, by Djerv, is a high-octane anthem that fuses unrelenting melody with pure metal ferocity, embodying Reignbreaker’s high-stakes, anti-establishment spirit.

Turn up the volume, break the reign.
